title: UAE Embassy Requirements Guidance
description: Prepare for a UAE document request using the current official service and mission instructions.
answer: The official UAE service determines the applicable route based on the document and issuing authority. We help you understand the request and organise preparation questions, without claiming embassy authority.

sections.title: Start with the receiving organisation
sections.text: Ask whether the document is for an employer, education provider, family process or business use. Obtain its instructions before selecting a service.

sections.title: Check the official channel
sections.text: Use the official UAE document service and the relevant mission’s instructions to establish the applicable application route. Availability and document eligibility must be checked there.

sections.title: Keep the scope clear
sections.text: We do not perform official authentication, replace applicant consent or claim approved courier status. Restricted steps stay with the applicant or the officially permitted provider.

sections.title: Document differences
sections.text: Compare names, dates and document titles before proceeding. Ask the issuing institution about incorrect information and the recipient about any accepted translation.

steps: Check the current official application route
